title: CWP/27550/2025 of ANIL RAO Vs STATE OF HARYANA AND ANOTHER
text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB AND HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH 121 CWP-27550-2025 Date of Decision:16.09.2025 ANIL RAO ….PETITIONER(S) VERSUS STATE OF HARYANA AND ANOTHER ….RESPONDENT(S) Present: Mr. Sudhir Hooda, Advocate for the petitioner. Mr. Sushil Bhardwaj, Addl. AG Haryana

1. This writ petition has been filed under Articles 226/227 of the Constitution of India in the nature of mandamus directing the respondents to release all pensionary benefits of the petitioner along with interest, which have been withheld despite withdrawal of punishment and dropping of charges vide order dated 25.11.2024 passed by the Government of Haryana (P-1), with further prayer to direct the respondent-Department to decide the representation dated 10.12 2024 (P-2) of the petitioner.

2. Notice of motion.

3. Mr. Sushil Bhardwaj, Addl. AG Haryana, having served with an advance copy of the petition, puts in appearance on behalf of the respondent-State and assures the Court that the representation dated 10.12.2024 (Annexure P-2) shall be decided by passing a speaking order in accordance with law within a period of 04 weeks from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this order. The order so passed shall be furnished to the petitioner within one week thereafter.

4. Petition stands disposed of in the aforesaid terms.

5. It is, however, made clear to the respondent-department that in case, the time frame, as stipulated above, is not adhered by the competent authority of the respondent-department, he/she shall be liable for facing proceedings under Contempt of Courts Act. (SANDEEP MOUDGIL) JUDGE 16.09.2025 NainaRajput
